changes.comment: sdk-ui-kit: Resizable sidebars slide in 300 ms by default instead of 500 ms. sdk-ui-dashboard: The dashboard side panels and the filter bar slide in 300 ms instead of 500 ms, also when the dashboard enters or leaves edit mode. The edit-mode panel items use the same icon set. In the collapsible panel they line up with the collapse button and turn darker in the collapsed rail, and the panel title, item labels and visualization list appear while the panel expands.
